name: datawebot
description: Ecommerce product data for agents: search products for sale across online shops worldwide, list every seller's price for one product with a direct link to each shop, and run extraction Jobs on Amazon search and product pages (10 countries), Walmart US, a set of reviewed stores and an endpoint directory of over 11,000 store domains (stores added through the automated probe are labelled "probe-qualified; live production acceptance pending"). Results are best-effort snapshots with their retrieval time; no price history or alerts. Hosted, closed-source remote server (the linked repository is the MIT-licensed connection kit). Sign in through your MCP client with OAuth 2.1 (email approval, free), or send an API key as an Authorization Bearer header. Jobs are paid in credits; new accounts start with 200 free trial credits.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server. Your MCP client runs the OAuth sign-in and you approve the email from datawebot; no API key is needed for that flow.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Lists every tool available now, including ones added after the session started. Call it first.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Products for sale across online shops worldwide, in local languages: title, price, original price, shop, rating, review count, image, condition, link and retrieval time. Filter by country and, optionally, by shop domains.

tools.name: get_product_offers
tools.description: For one product from a search: each seller's price, total with shipping, delivery note, seller rating and a direct link to the product page.

tools.name: list_job_blueprints
tools.description: Lists the extraction Job contracts available, with each contract's qualification and availability.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Starts an extraction Job on search results or product pages for a supported site.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns the status of an extraction Job.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Returns the rows an extraction Job produced.

examples.title: Compare sellers
examples.description: Find a product and list each seller's price with links
examples.prompt: Use datawebot to find who sells the Sony WH-1000XM5 in the US and for how much, with links to each shop.

examples.title: Amazon search
examples.description: Run an extraction Job on Amazon search results
examples.prompt: Use datawebot to search Amazon US for Nintendo Switch.
